remarks: Elegance, style, and thoughtful design converge in this stunning Westport residence, perfectly situated on a full acre of park-like grounds. Set back from the road, the property offers both privacy and convenience, just minutes from Saugatuck Center and downtown Westport. Inside, recent updates and tasteful renovations are showcased at every turn. The living room features a marble fireplace and serene views of the front and rear grounds, while a private office provides a tranquil retreat. The gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream, with a center island and seating, quartz countertops and backsplash, stainless steel appliances, a gas cooktop, pantry, and direct access to the patio. An open layout seamlessly connects the kitchen to a cozy sitting/breakfast area and a spacious dining and family room, complete with an accent fireplace and sliding doors overlooking the backyard. Upstairs, the primary suite is elegantly appointed with custom built-ins and a luxurious designer bath, complemented by two additional bedrooms and a beautifully finished second bath. The walk-out lower level offers versatile space for a recreation room, gym, or additional living area. Designed for both entertaining and everyday living, the home effortlessly blends indoor and outdoor spaces. Step outside to an exquisite patio with a sitting wall, pergola, and fire pit, opening onto an expansive backyard.
